author: Coco_stag
body:
Hello, I realised, now we are getting into staff application, there is going to be quite a few jr moderators. When these Jr Mods are doing their job, some times they're may be hackers. Jr Mods and players are stuck in-game with this fly hacker ruining gameplay, so I was thinking, if jr mods could do /freeze once they have all their evidence for a mod to come on; just so it doesn't affect gameplay. 

If a player leaves while frozen - this shouldn't be an issue, because the jr mod has all the evidence they need for a ban. 

If people try killing someone who is frozen - Maybe they could come invisible, or have resistance. I don't know?

Idea by LFT :)

replies.body:
The jr mod can freeze the hacker or team griefer until a mod comes. If he leaves, and there is no punishment, and lets say the jr mod doesn't remember the following name:

hacker6482638_urbad

then you are screwed. If you we're to temp ban him if he leaves while frozen, you can have time to review the evidence and look at the guys name in the recent infractions page. You can ban him for at least 4 hours to review the evidence, just in case.

He's going to get banned anyways, and if he doesn't and it is false, it will be like when you get a kick for client lag. It just makes everyone's life easier. Plus, they won't come back after they leave.

It only takes a few seconds to destroy the surrounding area while killing multiple teammates at the same time.

And it's not like we'd use /freeze before issuing out every punishment, just in extreme cases where the player needs to stop immediately.

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
If they tab and forget it then they can press t then press the up arrow, this will give them all the recent sentences they said in chat.
(Anyone can do this, I do it all the time)

If the player changes name while being frozen then they'd have to log out for the name change to take place. Even if they do, they would also have been frozen so the Jr.Mod can just check in his recent logs (with the technique I mentioned above) so that we can just do /name history on the player and get an ip check done on him.

If a Mod+ isn't on then the Jr.Mod will just have to record and give the evidence to a Mod+ later.

You said adding a couple hour punishment will help but if there's only a Jr.Mod on, they can't temp-ban him anyway because Jr.Mods can only warn and kick.
Which is why we encourage our Juniors to record and gather evidence when there are no Mods on to issue out temp-bans or perma-bans.

Regardless, there's always a way around every problem.
I think I've proved that by countering all of your hypothetical situations :P

In every situation, whether it's on Minecraft, the forums or on TeampSpesk, it's a staff member's job to defuse the situation and to find an appropriate solution.
